propositions: The enrichment queue reduce currently opens all matching event files per ticket on every drain gate check, causing 4,977+ file opens per invocation against a 20 ms budget and logs 404-654 ms latency breaches.
File open count grows unbounded as enrichment re-runs accumulate because _events_of loads all matching files three times per ticket in reduce_ticket without limiting the read set.

By reading event files newest-first and stopping on first valid parse (matching latest_ticket_digest pattern) and bounding claim arbitration to CLAIM events newer than latest ENQUEUE, file opens can be reduced to at most one per event type per ticket.
Event filename timestamp prefix is lexicographically ordered and matches the event body timestamp field, enabling safe suffix-scan ordering without disk format changes or file deletions.
The optimization pins the filename-to-body-timestamp coupling with a test to prevent silent misbehavior if future writers use different naming schemes.
